name: Spinach, Shrimp & Avocado Salad with Zesty Lemon Vinaigrette

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place in a large bowl, cover with water, and set aside to defrost. If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. Halve the tomatoes. Halve and pit the avocados; thinly slice the flesh crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Peel and mince the garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (142 g) pkg baby spinach
1 ½ pint grape tomatoes
3 avocados
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Drain the shrimp in a colander and run under cold water to melt any remaining ice chunks. Place on a clean towel (or paper towels) and pat dry.
Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add the shrimp and cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side.
In a small bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together lemon juice, olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
juice of 1 ½ lemon
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp honey
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, arrange a bed of spinach on a plate, top with the tomatoes, avocado and shrimp, and drizzle with the dressing. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
